request.query: x minus y divided by two equals x divided by two minus y divided by two

items.name: sub_div
items.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : DivisionRing K] (a b c : K), (a - b) / c = a / c - b / c

items.name: tsub_div
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]
  [inst_4 : Sub α] [OrderedSub α] (a b c : α), (a - b) / c = a / c - b / c

items.name: div_sub_div_same
items.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : DivisionRing K] (a b c : K), a / c - b / c = (a - b) / c

items.name: ofAdd_sub
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Sub α] (x y : α), Multiplicative.ofAdd (x - y) = Multiplicative.ofAdd x / Multiplicative.ofAdd y

items.name: sub_self_div_two
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Field α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (a : α), a - a / 2 = a / 2

items.name: Units.divp_sub_divp
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : CommRing α] (a b : α) (u₁ u₂ : αˣ), a /ₚ u₁ - b /ₚ u₂ = (a * ↑u₂ - ↑u₁ * b) /ₚ (u₁ * u₂)
